name: quicksave
description: A save point before compaction: the task's goal, step, branch, links, decisions, rules and next step are saved before /compact and handed back to the model after it, with a pixel-art SAVE POINT band when it is safe to compact.

warnAtPercent.title: Save point at (% of context)
warnAtPercent.description: Show the SAVE POINT band once the context window is this full and the session is idle.

writeFile.title: Mirror saves to a file
writeFile.description: Also write each save to <session cwd>/.claude/quicksave/<session id>.md. Off by default.
